title: Not What I Expected
text: Not What I Expected. This Christmas ornament was not at all what I was expecting. The pictures on the description led me to believe it was a 3-D chicken. Instead, it is a flat chicken. It's a color photo of a chicken (non-glossy) on wood. If you scroll through the product description, the very last thing it says in the 5th paragraph  is "Please note that this is a flat Christmas tree pendant, not three-". Obviously I didn't thoroughly read all of it or else I would have known. In all fairness, it is priced appropriately for what it is. I did have problems with the ribbon that was included. It was either stuck to the cardboard piece in the cello bag or it was caught on something because when I tried to remove it from the bag, it started fraying immediately. It was sticking to my arm and I had difficulties getting it off me. I can easily use my own ribbon or an ornament hanger, so that's not a big deal to me. My 3 star rating means this is okay. I don't love it, but I don't hate it either.
